decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable line that complements the firm's thermoforming portfolio, had its own page in both years observed, and costs little to carry, so the option is still worth holding.

A PETG thermoforming blank is a core, cheap-to-carry consumable for dental labs that fits the established material range and showed steady presence, so there is no sign that its value has failed to materialize.

The UV-curing lacquer was only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests modest prominence, but as a low-cost auxiliary material in the digital and additive workflow it still carries option value at little cost.

Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the firm's custom-device manufacturing strength in a growing occupational-safety market, but the sister earmold line was already dropped, so some risk remains that this one will be consolidated too.
